steps.code:
# Parse all notes to extract date and habit data
import re

parsed_data = []
habit_order = None

for note in note_contents:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in note['content'].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit_name = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[habit_name] = value
    
    # If first note, set habit_order
    if habit_order is None:
        habit_order = list(habits.keys())
    
    parsed_data.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_data)} notes")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First few dates:", [d['date'] for d in parsed_data[:5]])

# Parse all notes to extract date and habit data
import re

parsed_data = []
habit_order = None

for note in note_contents:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in note['content'].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit_name = parts[0].strip()
            value = parts[1].strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[habit_name] = value
    
    # If first note, set habit_order
    if habit_order is None:
        habit_order = list(habits.keys())
    
    parsed_data.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_data)} notes")
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("First few dates:", [d['date'] for d in parsed_data[:5]])
